title: Penalizing Product Excellence for User Oversight
body: App store rating systems are fundamentally broken if they allow people to blame a great product for their own inability to manage a calendar. Forgetting to cancel an active subscription is a lazy human error and a clear lack of attention to detail. It is completely wrong to let individual carelessness ruin an app’s reputation. Platforms need to fix this immediately. While the complaints of these incompetent users can remain visible for transparency, their scores should be completely blocked from affecting the overall star rating. An app's quality should never be penalized because a consumer lacks basic personal discipline.
